learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 198 COA links (one per lot): 156 distinct product-and-size titles, 142 products, lots from 2024 to 2026. The Squarespace shop (/shop) is merch only; the COA page is the only product list. Footer: '7 SEAZ PRODUCTS ARE MANUFACTURED & DISTRIBUTED BY A NYS LICENSED OPERATOR'; one catalog, New York only.
notes: Each <li> is one lab-tested lot: 'NAME - [LINE -] SIZE FORMAT - LOT#: 7SIF-022526-106'. The lot code's middle digits are a MMDDYY date. A product made in several lots is listed once per lot, so it becomes several entries under one product key; the matcher groups a product's entries, so that is harmless. The page keeps every lot since October 2024, so it includes products long sold through.

Text is mostly upper case, so strains come out upper case ('CHEESE QUAKE'); lines are set as constants. Separators vary ('LOT #:', 'LOT#:', 'LOT #', or no 'LOT' at all on the Tidal Waves multi-packs), so the rules anchor on the format words and never on the lot.

Lines: Mini Tsunami 0.6g and Tsunami 1.2g infused singles (read as one line, Tsunami, told apart by size: the stores' consensus has the minis as line Tsunami at 0.6g, and a separate Mini Tsunami line would not match it), Tidal Waves 5-pack (3.0G on its lots until the 2026 'PRE-ROLL MULTI-PACK' lots dropped the size; stores sell it at 3g), Wave Rider 1g disposables, Golden Sand kief (3.5g jars), High/Low/Night Tide tinctures, Beach Relief roll-on.
Tinctures and the roll-on name two cannabinoids ('1000MG CBD : 500MG THC'); the size is the THC figure, as stores list it.
